$comment: Project-local permissions. Read-only reference queries and the QC client are allowlisted so consulting an authority (CLAUDE.md section 4) is free rather than prompt-gated -- prompt friction is why references went unconsulted. Nothing here grants a write outside the repo, and no deploy, install, push or source-pack write is allowlisted. The deny list pins the source packs and third-party corpora read-only; references/stardew-official/ is our own generated mirror and stays writable so tools/index_stardew_reference.py can refresh it.
